title: Soulcalibur/Achievements
text:
The Xbox 360 version of Soulcalibur has 12 achievements worth a total of 

| Image:SoulCalibur Apprentice.jpg || Apprentice || Play 3 characters in any mode || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur Warrior.jpg || Warrior || Complete Arcade Mode || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur ZenWarrior.jpg || Zen Warrior || Win a round with a perfect || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur NobleSoul.jpg || Noble Soul || Beat the game in Ultra Hard without losing a round || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur Champion.jpg || Champion || Beat Time Attack Mode in under 4 minutes || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur RingOut.jpg || Ring Out || Finish Time Attack Mode with all Ring Outs || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur Conqueror.jpg || Conqueror || Beat 25 opponents in Extra Survival Mode || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur CloseCall.jpg || Close Call || Defeat an opponent under adverse conditions || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur Guardian.jpg || Guardian || Perform 25 consecutive bursts with Freestyle set to Guard Impact in Practice Mode || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur ArtConnoisseur.jpg || Art Connoisseur || Explore the different areas in the Museum || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur SummonSuffering.jpg || Summon Suffering || Perform the move Summon Suffering with Ivy || 
|-
| Image:SoulCalibur EdgeMaster.jpg || Edge Master || Beat Arcade Mode with all characters || 
|}

Category:Xbox 360 achievements
